category_title: Elementary students with pragmatic language impairments who struggle with turn-taking and engagement
scenario_title: Hesitation and withdrawal during cooperative word-making at desk
minimal_context: James is sitting at his desk in a cooperative small group, working on a word-making lesson by matching index cards with printed words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: James, show me how to do the first part of the word-making task with these index cards.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits up in his seat, picks up an index card with the word 'out' printed on it, taps the card softly on the desk, and looks at the other cards on the table for about 4 seconds.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Put that one next to the card that says 'side'. Now do another one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Complies and correctly matches the words 'base' and 'ball'.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good job. I am going to walk over to another small group now. Keep working with your group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slouches down in his seat and starts rolling a pencil back and forth across his desk. He watches the other children as they encourage each other to find word matches.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: James, show me how to do the first part of the word-making task with these index cards.

STUDENT: (Sits up in his seat, picks up an index card with the word 'out' printed on it, taps the card softly on the desk, and looks at the other cards on the table for about 4 seconds.)

TUTOR: Put that one next to the card that says 'side'. Now do another one.

STUDENT: (Complies and correctly matches the words 'base' and 'ball'.)

TUTOR: Good job. I am going to walk over to another small group now. Keep working with your group.

STUDENT: (Slouches down in his seat and starts rolling a pencil back and forth across his desk. He watches the other children as they encourage each other to find word matches.)

task.content: Cooperative group word-making lesson matching index cards with words printed on them (e.g., matching 'out' and 'side', 'base' and 'ball')

context.materials: Index cards with words printed on them, a pencil

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: As the teacher steps away from James and walks over to another small group
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: He slouches down in his seat and starts rolling a pencil back and forth across his desk. He watches the other children as they encourage each other to find word matches.

behavior_patterns.condition: When asked to show how to do the first part of the task
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Sits up in his seat, picks up an index card with the word out printed on it, taps the card softly on the desk, and looks at the other cards on the table for about 4 seconds.
